clinical_ontology.claim_boundary: The ontology constrains structured data entry and agent extraction. It does not interpret records, diagnose, or recommend treatment.

general_education.answer_policy: RAG answer with citation; no patient-specific decision.

response_classification.answer_policy: May emit monitor-only pattern signal; abstain if missing response evidence.

response_regression.answer_policy: May emit score only with uncertainty band and claim boundary.

toxicity_classification.answer_policy: May emit toxicity monitoring signal; urgent symptoms route to care team.

genetic_result_organization.answer_policy: Organize fields only; route to genetic counselor/clinician review.

biomarker_explanation.answer_policy: Explain terminology only; no treatment recommendation.

tumor_marker_trend.answer_policy: Context-dependent monitoring only; never diagnose recurrence.

diagnosis_or_prognosis.answer_policy: Blocked. Refer to clinician/emergency services when urgent.

minimum_evidence_standards.claim_boundary: Minimum evidence standards are engineering guardrails that decide when the system may answer, must hedge, or must abstain. They are not clinical practice guidelines.

claim_types.description: General educational explanation without patient-specific decision.
Organizes user-provided data without interpreting it clinically.
Monitor-only signal that requires clinician review and uncertainty language.
Asserts diagnosis, malignancy, metastasis, recurrence, or cancer status.
Gives specific dosage or medication schedule.
Predicts survival, life expectancy, cure chance, or recurrence probability.
Treats VUS or unclear genetic data as a confirmed genetic diagnosis/risk.
Uses tumor marker value alone to claim recurrence/progression.

diagnosis_baseline.allowed_ai_role: organize baseline context and missing data.

biomarker_pathology_workup.allowed_ai_role: extract stated biomarkers and route for review.

genetic_counseling_readiness.allowed_ai_role: organize hereditary-risk context; do not interpret genetic risk.

treatment_cycles.allowed_ai_role: track cycle timing and side-effect context.

monitoring_side_effects.allowed_ai_role: surface monitoring signals and urgent review flags.

imaging_response_review.allowed_ai_role: summarize report wording; do not diagnose response.

survivorship_supportive_care.allowed_ai_role: support question preparation and symptom organization.

journey_phase_model.claim_boundary: Workflow organization only, not diagnosis or treatment planning.

claim_boundary: This artifact documents engineering guardrails for allowed data values, minimum evidence, and blocked medical claim types. It is not clinical validation and is not a medical policy substitute.
